create_tabular_multiagent_ql_learner: create a MultiagentQLearner agent with a TwoPlayerNashSolver for joint-action Q-learning in two-player games
build_nash_solver: build a TwoPlayerNashSolver that computes Nash equilibria for two-player matrix games using support enumeration
solve_correlated_equilibrium: solve a correlated or coarse correlated equilibrium for multi-player games using CorrelatedEqSolver
compute_stackelberg_equilibrium: compute a Stackelberg equilibrium for two-player games with a specified leader player using StackelbergEqSolver
run_multiagent_q_learning: run multiagent Q-learning with joint action solver to update Q-values and select epsilon-greedy actions over game episodes
